name: Parallel SurfaceNets
definition: A high-performance, scalable isocontouring algorithm for discrete, segmented scalar data that produces an output triangle mesh enclosing each segmented region. It performs independent threaded operations across volume edges, resulting in scalable performance through task-stealing and edge-based computational tasks.
summary: Parallel SurfaceNets is a high-performance parallel algorithm that extracts shared boundary meshes from volumetric label maps in a single pass, avoiding the duplicated polygons and memory bottlenecks of sequential methods like Marching Cubes.
